info.title: API.SH: IKEA
info.description: The IKEA API from API.SH: public IKEA data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The products in an IKEA category, like the category page: name, item number, type, measurements, price and currency, previous price and price tag, rating and count, colours, availability flags, badge, variants, link and images, with `raw`. `total` is the site's count; the available sort options and every filter group with its values and counts come with the list. Sort and filter exactly as on the site. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ikea-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The category id at the end of an ikea.com category link (`/cat/tables-chairs-fu002/` is `fu002`), or the link.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Country and language as in ikea.com links (default us/en), e.g. `gb/en`, `de/de`, `se/sv`.

parameters.name: f-ratings
parameters.description: Minimum customer rating ids, comma separated.

parameters.name: f-doors
parameters.description: Number of doors ids, comma separated.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One IKEA product by link: item number, name, type, price and currency, availability, rating and count, description, category, colour, width/depth/height, designer, materials, care instructions, good-to-know notes, measurements, packages, colour and size options (each with item number, link and price), highlighted reviews and images. With `stock=true` (or `store_id`) also `stock`: online availability (home delivery, click and collect, stock level) and, per store in that market, store id, name, city, stock level, quantity, restock date and quantity, and aisle and bin. With `zip`, also `delivery`: home-delivery availability to that postcode.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ikea-product

parameters.name: stock
parameters.description: true: add `stock` (online and per-store availability with quantities, restock dates and aisle locations).

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Only this store's stock (a `store_id` from `stock.stores`, e.g. 026). Implies `stock=true`; 404 if the store has no record for the item.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: A postcode or ZIP code in the product's country: adds `delivery`, home-delivery availability to that address as the product page shows it (available, in range, stock level, parcel or truck, limited delivery methods, notify-me flag, click and collect). Delivery prices are only given at checkout and are not included.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products IKEA shows under a product page: similar products or more from the same series, with the same fields as search (id, name, type, price, rating, colours, link, images).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ikea-recommendations

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A product's customer reviews on IKEA: rating and rating range, title, text, author, date, country and language of the review, sub-ratings (appearance, quality, value, ease of assembly), recommended, verified purchase, helpful votes, photos and IKEA replies, with `raw`. The summary has the average rating, rating count, distribution and sub-rating averages. Filter by stars, verified purchase, photos, review language or market-only reviews; sort by recent, oldest, highest or lowest rated, or most helpful. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ikea-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The 8-digit item number at the end of an ikea.com product link, e.g. `30605423`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An ikea.com product link instead of `id`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words instead of `id`: the reviews of the first search result.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Country and language as in ikea.com links (default us/en), e.g. `gb/en`, `de/de`, `se/sv`.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with these stars, 1-5, comma separated, e.g. `1,2`.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Only reviews written in this language (two-letter code, e.g. `en`, `de`).

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `all` (default) includes reviews from every IKEA market; `local` only those written in this market.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products on IKEA for keywords in one market (country/language as in ikea.com links), with sort and the site's filters (type, colour, price bucket, size, material, category, seats, features, shape, series, new, offers, rating, best seller, last chance; values from `filters`). Each product: id, item number, name, type, measure, price, currency, previous price and price tag, rating and count, colours, online-sellable and last-chance flags, badge, category, variant count, link and images. `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (up to 10 pages).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ikea-search

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: country/language: us/en (default), gb/en, de/de, fr/fr, se/sv, in/en, ...

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, newest, rating, name.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every IKEA store of a market: id, name, address, city, ZIP, state, time zone, coordinates, store page, opening date, opening hours and special (holiday) hours, and the pickup and cash-and-carry flags. Filter by name, city or ZIP with `q`; use an id with /ikea/v1/product?store_id= for its stock.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ikea-stores

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Country/language as in ikea.com links (default us/en).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only stores whose name, city or ZIP contains this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
